newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian police free hostages in jail drama.
newsitem.headline: Austrian police free hostages in jail drama.

text.p: Austrian special police forces overpowered hostage-takers in a jail in the southern town of Graz on Thursday night and freed three women prison staff without bloodshed, the interior ministry said.
The women were unharmed but were being treated in hospital for shock after 10 hours in captivity.
The three prisoners involved, including Palestinian Tawfik ben Ahmed Chaovali, convicted for a 1985 bomb attack at Vienna airport, were now back behind bars.
The incident began on Thursday morning when the prisoners in the high-security jail seized three canteen staff, demanding eight million schillings ($755,000) and a getaway helicopter.
The prisoners had apparently strapped explosives to their hostages and had threatened to kill them.
Two guards were stabbed during the incident. They were flown to hospital and were in stable condition.
